    NON-ENERGIZED DIGITAL REHEARSAL

    Follow one carrier to the reactor seat and back

    This prototype exposes a cutaway of the two mechanical axes for learning where the carrier is. It represents the guard checks in software, not real lockout or hardware procedures. It does not model actual controller menus, gases, vacuum, temperatures, processing recipes, deposition, or film growth.

    1. Load: Open the outer lid, load the example carrier, close the lid, and open the inner gate.
    2. Send: Lift the support to pick up the carrier, extend the arm, lower onto the receiver, retract the empty arm, and close the gate.
    3. Return: Open the gate, extend the empty arm at its low position, lift the carrier, retract, lower onto the load-lock seat, and close the gate.
    4. Recover: Open the outer lid, unload and export the custody record. Use the cutaway to see the same carrier in each position.
    Primary evidence and verification

    Model and sources. A single-reactor Veeco Fiji G2 and automatic load lock, as described by the University of Florida exact installation. The installed HMI, Fig. 1 verifies that the instrument runs transfers automatically. These indexed cutaway buttons are teaching controls, not a copy of the HMI.

    The Veeco G2 catalog gives a nominal standard package of 1,845 × 715 × 1,920 mm (listed in that order; modeled W × D × H according to proportions). The exact receiver and gate geometry, outer lid angle and stroke are inferred. Related G2.2 documentation supports the two-axis abstraction, not UF serial-specific measurements.

    Acceptance case. Exactly one tagged carrier and witness must advance through six owner changes. A closed-gate crossing does not move the arm or create an accepted event. Merely crossing the gate or returning an untransferred carrier does not produce a completed custody export.

    Contract. bts.inert-carrier.v1 imports stable carrier/witness identifiers and revisions. bts.fiji-carrier-custody.v1 reports the ordered transitions, source identity and unchanged witness revision. It does not characterize films, change material state, or supply machine settings.
